post.originalText:
I just wanted a peaceful pond. Now the fish are having an earthquake and the frog has questions for the landlord 🐸📷 

Asked Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra to make a jelly koi pond  

Opus made an entire gummy aquarium for $12.38. Thick, transparent, little pebbles inside. Give it a pull - and the pond takes off with everyone still in it. The frog is holding onto its lily pad. The mortgage isn’t paid off yet  

Astra’s $15.57 pond is thinner, but the flowers are bigger and the fish have fancy patterns. Lift the edge - and the whole thing folds into a pancake. Started as a Japanese garden, ended up as a fish wrap  

I prefer Opus here - the jelly looks juicier, and it cost $3.19 less  

Who would you trust to build your frog’s home?
